name: Board of Library Trustees - Jun 10, 2026
agenda_text:
CITY OF BURBANK BOARD OF LIBRARY TRUSTEES
  AGENDA
  Wednesday, June 10, 2026
  5:30 PM, Burbank Central Library, 110 N. Glenoaks Blvd

This agenda contains a summary of each item of business the Board of Library Trustees may discuss or act
on at this meeting. The agenda packet consisting of minutes, staff reports and other documentation is on file
in the office of the Library Services Department, located at 110 N. Glenoaks Blvd. The agenda will be posted
on the City’s website at www.burbankca.gov. If you have a question about any matter on the agenda, call the
Library Services Department at (818) 238-5551. The facility is disabled-accessible. Auxiliary aids and services
are available for individuals with speech, vision or hearing impairments with 48-hour advance notice. Contact
the ADA coordinator at (818) 238-5051 with questions or concerns.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Regular Board of Library Trustees Meeting will be held on Wednesday,
June 10, 2026, at 5:30 p.m., at the Burbank Central Library Auditorium, 110 N. Glenoaks Boulevard, 2nd Floor,
Burbank, to discuss matters on the attached agenda.

Public Comment Options: To speak during Public Comment, members of the public may speak for three
minutes in-person at the Burbank Central Library Auditorium or via web conference. In order to comment via
web conference, you must contact Library Administration at (818) 238-5551 by noon on Wednesday, June
10, 2026, in order to receive a link or call-in number. Members of the public who attend in person will speak
first, followed by any remote participants.

Interpretation Requests:
If you would like to participate in Public Comments and require an interpreter, please telephone the City
Clerk’s Office at (818) 238-5851 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
Si desea participar en los comentarios públicos y necesita un intérprete, por favor llame a la Oficina de la
Secretaria Municipal al (818) 238-5851 al menos 48 horas antes de la reunión.
Եթե ցանկանում եք մասնակցել հանրային մեկնաբանություններին և թարգմանիչ եք պահանջում,
խնդրում ենք զանգահարել քաղաքապետարանի գրասենյակ՝ (818) 238-5851 հեռախոսահամարով
հանդիպումից 48 ժամ առաջ:

  1. Call to Order: 5:30 pm
  2. Roll Call
  3. Announcements
  4. Public Comment (3-minute limit on any matter concerning Library business)
  5. Approval of Minutes: May 13, 2026
  6. Presentations
  a. Library Services Update
  b. Friends of the Library Update
  The mission of the Burbank Board of Library Trustees is to advocate for Library needs and improved services,
  to foster connections between the community and the Library, and to advise City Council regarding plans,
  policies and resources to sustain a thriving and ever-changing Burbank Public Library.
 7. Reports
  a. Library Safety Update
8. Board Member Comments
9. Introduction of Additional Agenda Items and Calendar Review
  a. Reminder: No July meeting
10. Adjournment to Wednesday, August 12, 2026, for a regular meeting in-person at the
  Central Library.

  Posted by: M. Lund
  Posted Date: June 5, 2026
